name: LM 4 DS
about: LM 4 DS (1969-043C), a crewed vehicle (LM DS), launched 1969 May 18. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DSA).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1969 May 18), held fixed
